rules.statement: A right of way over a neighbor's land can be granted if the alternative route is so difficult and inconvenient as to be practically impossible, especially in an urban area.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion, reasonable compensation or the just price the plaintiff must pay would be the market value of the strip of land. According to plan P. 1, lot has been surveyed as an area covering 2 .86 perches. The learned District Judge has stated in the course of his judgment that in the event of this Court disagreeing with his view that the route over the sea-shore constitutes reasonable access to the plaintiff's land, compensation shot calculated at Rs. 15,000 an acre which, according to the 1st defendant himself, is the price of land in this locality. On this basis, the value of lot 'Y' works out to Rs. 268, and I would order that a sum of RS.300 be paid to the defendants by the plaintiff as compensation for the which I decree to her of a right of footway from her land over in plan P. 1 to Gunananda Place."
